newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat stalls on pool, demand uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat stalls on pool, demand uncertainty.

text.p: Australian wheat futures stalled and were untraded on Monday as uncertainty dominated the market.
Settlement prices on nearer-term contracts fell by about A$4.00-A$5.00 a tonne but were mostly steady on more distant contracts.

The Australian Wheat Board is scheduled to revise its pool prices on Monday afternoon, an event which Australian grain markets have looked toward expectantly. If the pool is closed, prices would normally fall.

But Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said that pool price uncertainty alone would not account for the total absence of trades on Monday. Ords was a seller of March, May and July contracts, he said.
Chicago's continued decline and Australia's exceptional wheat export performance raised uncertainty about the future course of world demand, he said.
